findings.title: Metric alert detector handler is now uninstantiable
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract requirements (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Any detector with type `metric_alert_fire` will raise `TypeError` when `Detector.detector_handler` tries to instantiate this handler, rather than safely evaluating to no results as it did before. Keep this as a concrete `DetectorHandler` until the stateful methods are implemented, or implement all required hooks.

findings.title: The evaluate docstring still describes the old list return type
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` now returns a dictionary keyed by `DetectorGroupKey`, but its docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. This documents the obsolete API contract and will mislead future handler implementations and callers.

findings.title: Occurrence tests do not verify that each group's value reaches the new hook
findings.body: The packet gives `group_2` the value `10`, but the expected occurrence is constructed with `6`; the helper also ignores its `value` parameter. Similar tests construct expected occurrences with values different from the input packet. Consequently, the tests would still pass if `evaluate_group_key_value` passed a stale or incorrect value to `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, leaving the new hook's key input untested. Make the mock occurrence/event data depend on `value` and expect the packet's actual per-group value.
